summary: One church. Both November issues (image-only) print the same Mass, confession and Adoration schedule, matching the website homepage. Open: Tuesday Adoration in the convent ends at 7:45 PM (box and calendar) or 8:00 PM (flyer). The website's January 2026 'one daily Mass' change page is contradicted by current bulletins and left out.

slots.rationale: C8: the schedule box and the weekly calendar of both issues end it at 7:45 PM with Night Prayer; the flyer on p3 says 8:00 PM. Leaning 7:45: two service-specific listings against one, as in st-thomas-the-apostle-glen-mills s13 and st-laurence-upper-darby s17. Place: the calendar puts it in the Convent, which the parish history places on the parish property with the church (POLICY: a chapel on the same grounds belongs to the church); the parish's own box lists it as its public Adoration. No exposition word is printed, though the flyer shows a monstrance; none claimed beyond 'Adoration' (R38).

sources.said: We will have 2 daily Masses during the seasons of Advent & Lent! Monday-Friday – 7:00am & 8:30am Masses ONLY during Advent & Lent

slots.rationale: R6: the page announced a January 2026 schedule (one daily Mass; Tue/Wed 8:30 only) that the November Ordinary-Time bulletins and intentions contradict (Tue-Fri 7:00 and 8:30), and the homepage gives Monday 8:30 only, so it is an earlier period's announcement. Its Advent Monday 7 AM is not trusted; Advent's dates also can't be written as months (R33). December bulletins will show any Advent change.
